title: Canonical affine edge on upper truncation
statement: Let f:X\to Y be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Write F for direct image to f_*\mathcal O_X-modules [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], with total right derived functor RF [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Assume derived categories on both module-sheaf categories and enough injectives on X. Let I be a cochain complex with quasi-coherent cohomology in every degree [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and n\in\mathbf Z. Write h for the chosen left homology data of I.sc(n), so h.K is cycles, h.fprime is the differential into cycles and h.pi is the homology projection. Let A=\tau_{\le n}I and let c:\operatorname{coker}(F(h.fprime))\to H^n(RF(QA)) be the composite of the canonical cokernel-to-homology isomorphism, the inverse of H^n(F(A\to I)), the localization homology comparison, and H^n of the derived unit at A [lem-sc-left-exact-upper-truncation-comparison]. There exists an isomorphism e:H^n(RF(QA))\to F(h.H) such that \operatorname{coker}\pi\,c\,e=F(h.pi). No K-injectivity or boundedness of I is assumed.

proof.text: Use the single-object derived identification to transport affine higher-image vanishing to positive homology of derived direct image on single quasi-coherent modules. For the affine morphism, positive higher direct images of quasi-coherent modules vanish. Apply the natural acyclic quasi-coherent derived-pushforward comparison to the canonical derived lower-truncation projection. Both its source and target have quasi-coherent homology, and its degree-n source homology is invertible. Naturality therefore makes degree-n derived pushforward of this projection invertible over O_Y. Restriction of scalars from f_*O_X to O_Y is exact and conservative: the underlying abelian sheaf is unchanged. Its derived-composition and homology comparisons transport and reflect this invertibility over f_*O_X.

Apply the lower-truncation cycle formula to F and I, obtaining the canonical bottom isomorphism b with its cycle-class identity. Compose b with degree-n derived direct image of the lower-truncation projection and of the upper-truncation inclusion. The first arrow is invertible by step 1, and the second by the left-exact upper-truncation derived comparison. Their composition is the required edge isomorphism e.

Expand upperTruncationBoundaryComparison. Naturality of the complex derived unit and of the localization homology factor isomorphism cancels the inverse raw upper-truncation homology map against the derived upper-truncation inclusion. The mapped left-homology-data identity identifies the cokernel projection followed by its homology isomorphism inverse with the cycle lift followed by the homology quotient; kernel uniqueness identifies this lift with the prescribed F of the cycle inclusion. The quotient-to-homotopy factor identity identifies the remaining localization comparisons with those in the lower-truncation cycle formula. Its cycle-class identity then proves cokernel.pi c e = F(h.pi). All constructions work for unbounded complexes, zero complexes, empty schemes and arbitrary integer n.

proof_origin.note: Uses the existing natural acyclic-pushforward comparison to detect invertibility and the existing lower-truncation cycle formula to preserve the canonical map identity; private abstract helpers avoid expanding geometric data in the composition proof.

theorem affine_algebra_upper_truncation_edge
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hI : ∀ n : ℤ, (I.homology n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ) :
    let F := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)
    ∃ e : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) n).obj
        (F.rightDerivedFunctor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (I.truncLE n))) ≅
        F.obj (I.sc n).homologyData.left.H,
      cokernel.π (F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.f') ≫
          F.upperTruncationBoundaryComparison I n ≫ e.hom =
        F.map (I.sc n).homologyData.left.π
